__prompts__.component: Component folder, and the prefix of everything it creates outside it (lowercase, e.g. langfuse)
__prompts__.gcp_project_id: GCP project id — one project per environment
__prompts__.gcp_region: GCP region for the cluster, Cloud SQL, Memorystore and the bucket
__prompts__.github_repository: owner/name of the repository this component lives in (Workload Identity trusts it by name)

profile.small: small: one ClickHouse replica, zonal Cloud SQL Enterprise, Basic Redis (~$250-330/month)
profile.ha: ha: the module's defaults, three ClickHouse replicas, regional Enterprise Plus, Standard HA Redis (~$1,000/month)

__prompts__.hostname: Hostname Langfuse is served on, e.g. langfuse.example.com (you delegate DNS for it after the first apply)

cluster_mode.new: new: the official module creates a GKE Autopilot cluster and its VPC
cluster_mode.existing: existing: install into a GKE cluster you already run in this project

__prompts__.existing_cluster_location: Existing cluster's region or zone (cluster_mode=existing only)
__prompts__.state_bucket: GCS bucket for Terraform state: a new name, or an existing bucket to share (state goes under <component>/<env>)
